svg.aria-label: Iso-Token Phase Space of GitHub Copilot Coding Throughput vs Wall-Clock Time
svg.text: Phase-Space Telemetry · 6 Coding Scenarios × 28 Models (168 Runs)
The Speed–Verbosity Phase Space: Why High tok/s Does Not Always Mean Fast Code
Mean coding throughput (tok/s) vs. mean wall-clock completion time (s). Bubble area encodes mean output token volume; dashed curves trace iso-token contours.
I. Pareto Sprinters (Fast Wall-Clock + High tok/s)
Optimal interactive coding zone (<17s wall time, >40 tok/s)
II. Verbose Heavyweights (High tok/s via Volume)
1,000–1,634 avg tokens amortize initial latency over 20–32s runs
III. Terse Finishers (Fast Wall-Clock, Compact Output)
Finishes in 13–15s, but 460–560 tok volume compresses end-to-end tok/s
IV. Latency Drag (Slower Completion & Lower Throughput)
Extended generation times (>18s) without high token volume
